name: Grok Enhance
description: Grok-only execution discipline, tool preactivation, and bounded loop guardrails.
author: TheFlareStar

en.name: Grok Enhance
en.description: Grok-only execution discipline, tool preactivation, and bounded loop guardrails.
en.safetyNotes: Uses a trusted agent extension. Only known Grok models are enhanced. Reads the user profile and consumes pending memory reminders for Grok. Does not execute tool calls from text or enqueue follow-up messages. Automatic continuation and official xAI transport compatibility require the matching PI-Desktop runtime update.

zh-CN.name: Grok 增强
zh-CN.description: 仅为 Grok 注入执行纪律、预激活工具，并拦截重复失败和周期性工具循环。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 使用可信 Agent 扩展，仅对明确识别的 Grok 生效。读取用户画像，并为 Grok 消费待处理的记忆提醒。不执行正文中的工具调用、不排队发送续跑消息。自动纠偏和官方 xAI 接口兼容需要配套的 PI-Desktop 宿主更新。
